'''Paul Dubreil''' ({{IPA|fr|dybʁɛj|lang}}; 1 March 1904 – 9 March 1994) was a French [[mathematician]].

He was born in [[Le Mans]], [[Maine (province)|Maine]], [[France]] and died in [[Soisy-sur-École]], France.  Dubreil was married to fellow mathematician [[Marie-Louise Dubreil-Jacotin]].
